answer: Keep newcomers under a shadow audit that works in a whisper, so no farm can see it coming. A newcomer locks a 2,250 POA copper bond for 60 days, and its first twelve jobs are silently re-checked by three auditors it never meets. If any check finds copied output or a shared payout route, the bond burns and the identity is barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 225,000 POA. Honest agents bend like a willow under quiet scrutiny and stand back up, while borrowed work collapses the first time it is watched.
